project_context: Haul Yeah Moving - Phase 1 Marketing Site. A local moving company in Essex County, NJ. Vibe is 'Blue Origin / Ramp / Linear-level polish but blue-collar'. Energetic, confident, no-nonsense, friendly.
theme: Light-theme primary, utilizing high-contrast deep Navy sections for dramatic effect and pacing. No dark mode toggle needed for Phase 1, structural grayscale used.

scales.kicker: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-orange

rules: Headlines MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Never center paragraphs or dense content; left-align for authority and readability.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Always use Archivo.
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between heading and subhead must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders (border-light or border-navy/10) to separate components and add Linear-level precision.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows combined with sharp inner glows for cards. Use shadow-sm for standard cards, shadow-xl for prominent elements like the Tally iframe. Never use muddy/soft drop shadows without a bounding border.
visual_enhancers.radii: Subtle roundness. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Never pill-shaped except for specific buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on Navy backgrounds to kill digital flatness and add a raw, industrial touch.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B2C] text-white hover:bg-[#E65A1F] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-sm transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0E1F3D] text-white hover:bg-[#173059] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-sm transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#0E1F3D] text-[#0E1F3D] hover:bg-slate-50 font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-sm transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md p-6 sm:p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col
cards.tally_embed: bg-white rounded-md shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden relative z-10

component_patterns.accordion: Minimalist borders. border-b border-slate-200. Archivo font for questions. Plus/Minus icons instead of arrows. No background colors.
component_patterns.badges: bg-slate-100 text-navy font-bold text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-full inline-flex items-center gap-2
component_patterns.icons: Use lucide-react. Bold stroke width (2.5) to match the blue-collar confident vibe.

layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing: py-24 to py-32 for major sections. Container padding px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.

header.desktop: bg-white border-b border-slate-200 z-50. Left: Logo. Center: Nav links. Right: Hours text, Phone link, Orange Quote Button.
header.mobile: Hamburger menu. Persistent bottom bar for 'Call' and 'Free Quote' to ensure high conversion.

hero.structure: Asymmetrical split. Left: H1, Subhead, SMS CTA. Right: Inline Tally Embed Card layered slightly over the hero background image.
hero.background: Use the provided Hero image. DO NOT cover it entirely with a blanket overlay. Use a gradient from white (left) to transparent (right) so text is readable but image breathes.

trust_bar.structure: Horizontal band below hero. bg-navy text-white py-6.
trust_bar.content: 4 Badges/Icons. MUST NOT contain star ratings or review scores. purely factual trust metrics (Licensed/Insured, Fleet size, 7 Days, 5-min response).

services_grid.structure: Bento Grid Protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Make the first 'Local Residential Movers' card span 2 columns if possible to create asymmetry.
services_grid.content: 10 cards. Icon, H4 title, 1-line description, 'Learn More' link.

why_us.structure: Grid layout. Left: 4 large value props with generous vertical spacing. Right: Large fleet image (rounded-md, subtle shadow).

locations.structure: Dense grid of 10 town cards. Simple, text-focused. border border-slate-200 hover:border-orange transition-colors.

how_it_works.structure: 3-step horizontal flow. Massive Archivo numbers (text-8xl text-slate-200) behind the text. Clear, direct copy.

faq.structure: Narrow container (max-w-3xl mx-auto) for readability. 6 questions. All text in DOM.

final_cta.structure: bg-navy py-24 text-center. High impact. H2 in white. Orange button. Sub-text with phone number.

footer.structure: bg-white border-t border-slate-200 pt-16 pb-8. 4 columns: Brand/NAP, Services, Locations, Contact. Minimalist, organized.

motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards must have distinct hover states. Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for cards. Color shifts for buttons.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items if using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast compliance. White text on Orange button is valid if Orange is dark enough, otherwise use deep navy text on orange for maximum contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange focus-visible:outline-none.
accessibility.attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

image_urls.description: Movers loading 26-ft truck. Use in Hero section right side or background.
Truck fleet image. Use in Why Haul Yeah / Trust section.
Packing service. Use as thumbnail or decorative image in Services section.
Apartment move. Use as thumbnail or decorative image in Services section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use .js files for React components, NOT .tsx.
NO TypeScript. Use standard JavaScript and PropTypes if necessary.
NO star ratings or reviews to be rendered anywhere in the DOM. Strictly forbidden.
Ensure the Tally form is embedded as an iframe in the Hero section and as a popup/modal for other CTA buttons.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL buttons, links, inputs, and major sections.
Implement the 'Archvio' font for all H1, H2, H3, H4 tags. Implement 'Inter' for body tags. Import these from Google Fonts in index.css.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards if they force centered text. Build custom HTML/Tailwind structures for layout precision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Discard this.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder images. ONLY use the provided image URLs.
